questions.subsection: Microsoft AI Agents for Beginners, Tool Use, lines 27–29
questions.stem: Which option best describes a tool in the source’s design pattern?

options.A: Only a sentence in the system prompt
options.B: A final answer already written by the model
options.C: Executable code such as a function or an API call
options.D: A replacement for all conversation messages

questions.explanation: A tool is code that can be executed to perform actions, including simple functions and external API calls.

option_analysis.A: A description can explain a tool, but it is not the executable capability.
option_analysis.B: A final answer is distinct from the tool.
option_analysis.D: The pattern still needs message handling.

questions.subsection: Microsoft AI Agents for Beginners, Tool Use, lines 61–173
questions.stem: An agent returns a function name and location arguments for a time lookup. What should the application do next?

options.A: Display the function name as the current time
options.B: Skip execution and invent the tool result
options.D: Execute the selected function with those arguments

questions.explanation: Original scenario: the returned call requests execution. The function’s result must then be returned to the model.

option_analysis.A: The function name is not the requested information.
option_analysis.B: The source requires executing the function.
option_analysis.C: The example preserves messages for the next turn.
option_analysis.D: This is the next step in the source’s loop.

steps: Distinguish a tool call from a final answer.

questions.subsection: Microsoft AI Agents for Beginners, Tool Use, lines 329–333
questions.stem: An agent is intended to answer questions by reading a database. Which access arrangement follows the lesson’s recommendation?

options.A: Give it permission to drop tables so every request succeeds
options.C: Assign restricted read-only access, such as a SELECT role
options.D: Rely on the tool’s name instead of database permissions

questions.explanation: Original scenario: the lesson recommends read-only database configuration and a read-only SELECT role for the named database services.

option_analysis.A: Dropping tables exceeds the source’s reading boundary.
option_analysis.B: Unrestricted administration conflicts with the recommendation.
option_analysis.C: This implements the stated restricted reading access.
option_analysis.D: Naming is not the permission configuration described.

steps: Apply the source’s restricted access recommendation.
